﻿# Fix Maven Compilation Failure: tinspin-indexes 1.7.1 -> 1.8.0

## Context

Project `PGS` (by micycle1) has a **COMPILATION_FAILURE** after a dependency upgrade bot bumped
`org.tinspin:tinspin-indexes` from `1.7.1` to `1.8.0` (minor update).

Reference PR: https://github.com/micycle1/PGS/pull/92

## Your Task

The source code is in `/PGS`. Fix all compilation errors so that `mvn compile` succeeds.
I'll analyze the compilation failure caused by the `tinspin-indexes` upgrade and fix it.

						<goals>
							<goal>report</goal>
						</goals>
					</execution>
				</executions>
			</plugin>
		</plugins>
	</build>

										<exclude>**/*.txt</exclude>
										<exclude>**/*.ttf</exclude>
										<exclude>**/*.svg</exclude>
										<exclude>**/*.gif</exclude>
										<exclude>**/*.jpg</exclude>
										<exclude>**/*.properties</exclude>

								</filter>
							</filters>
							<artifactSet>
								<excludes>
									<exclude>processing:*</exclude>
								</excludes>
							</artifactSet>
						</configuration>
						<executions>
							<execution>
								<phase>package</phase>
								<goals>
									<goal>shade</goal>
								</goals>
							</execution>
						</executions>
					</plugin>
				</plugins>
			</build>
		</profile>

			<id>local-processing</id>
			<build>
				<plugins>
					<plugin>
						<groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
						<artifactId>maven-shade-plugin</artifactId>

									<excludes>

										<exclude>**/*.png</exclude>
										<exclude>**/*.svg</exclude>
										<exclude>**/*.gif</exclude>
										<exclude>**/*.jpg</exclude>
										<exclude>**/*.properties</exclude>
										<exclude>processing/**</exclude>
									</excludes>
								</filter>
							</filters>
						</configuration>
						<executions>

								<goals>

<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
	xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
	xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
	<modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
	<groupId>micycle</groupId>
	<artifactId>PGS</artifactId>
	<version>1.3.1-SNAPSHOT</version>
	<name>Processing Geometry Suite</name>
	<description>Geometric algorithms for Processing</description>

	<properties>
		<sonar.projectKey>micycle1_PTS</sonar.projectKey>
		<sonar.organization>micycle</sonar.organization>
		<sonar.host.url>https://sonarcloud.io</sonar.host.url>
		<processing.library.dir>${user.home}\Documents\Processing\libraries\PGS\library</processing.library.dir>
	</properties>

	<build>
		<plugins>
			<plugin>
				<groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
				<artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
				<version>3.11.0</version>
				<configuration>
					<release>8</release>
					<source>8</source>
					<target>8</target>
					<compilerArgs>
						<arg>-Xplugin:jabel</arg>
					</compilerArgs>
				</configuration>
			</plugin>
			<plugin>
				<groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
				<artifactId>maven-source-plugin</artifactId>
				<version>3.3</version>
				<executions>
					<execution>
						<id>attach-sources</id>
						<phase>deploy</phase>
						<goals>
							<goal>jar-no-fork</goal>
						</goals>
					</execution>
				</executions>
			</plugin>
			<plugin>
				<groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
				<artifactId>maven-javadoc-plugin</artifactId>
				<version>3.5.0</version>
				<configuration>
					<failOnError>false</failOnError>
					<subpackages>micycle.pgs.*</subpackages>
				</configuration>
				<executions>
					<execution>
						<id>attach-javadocs</id>
						<goals>
							<goal>jar</goal>
						</goals>
					</execution>
				</executions>
			</plugin>
			<plugin> <!-- for test running -->
				<artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
				<version>3.1.0</version>
			</plugin>
			<plugin>
				<groupId>org.jacoco</groupId>
				<artifactId>jacoco-maven-plugin</artifactId>
				<version>0.8.8</version>
				<executions>
					<execution>
						<goals>
							<goal>prepare-agent</goal>
						</goals>
					</execution>
					<execution>
						<id>generate-code-coverage-report</id>
						<phase>test</phase>
						<goals>
							<goal>report</goal>
						</goals>
					</execution>
				</executions>
			</plugin>
		</plugins>
	</build>

	<profiles>
		<profile>
			<id>uber-jar</id>
			<build>
				<plugins>
					<plugin>
						<groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
						<artifactId>maven-shade-plugin</artifactId>
						<version>3.5.0</version>
						<configuration>
							<createDependencyReducedPom>false</createDependencyReducedPom>

<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
	xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
	xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
	<modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>
	<groupId>micycle</groupId>
	<artifactId>PGS</artifactId>
	<version>1.3.1-SNAPSHOT</version>
	<name>Processing Geometry Suite</name>
	<description>Geometric algorithms for Processing</description>

	<properties>
		<sonar.projectKey>micycle1_PTS</sonar.projectKey>
		<sonar.organization>micycle</sonar.organization>
		<sonar.host.url>https://sonarcloud.io</sonar.host.url>
		<processing.library.dir>${user.home}\Documents\Processing\libraries\PGS\library</processing.library.dir>
	</properties>

	<build>
		<plugins>
			<plugin>
				<groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
				<artifactId>maven-compiler-plugin</artifactId>
				<version>3.11.0</version>
				<configuration>
					<release>8</release>
					<source>8</source>
					<target>8</target>
					<compilerArgs>
						<arg>-Xplugin:jabel</arg>
					</compilerArgs>
				</configuration>
			</plugin>
			<plugin>
				<groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
				<artifactId>maven-source-plugin</artifactId>
				<version>3.3</version>
				<executions>
					<execution>
						<id>attach-sources</id>
						<phase>deploy</phase>
						<goals>
							<goal>jar-no-fork</goal>
						</goals>
					</execution>
				</executions>
			</plugin>
			<plugin>
				<groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
				<artifactId>maven-javadoc-plugin</artifactId>
				<version>3.5.0</version>
				<configuration>
					<failOnError>false</failOnError>
					<subpackages>micycle.pgs.*</subpackages>
				</configuration>
				<executions>
					<execution>
						<id>attach-javadocs</id>
						<goals>
							<goal>jar</goal>
						</goals>
					</execution>
				</executions>
			</plugin>
			<plugin> <!-- for test running -->
				<artifactId>maven-surefire-plugin</artifactId>
				<version>3.1.0</version>
			</plugin>
			<plugin>
				<groupId>org.jacoco</groupId>
				<artifactId>jacoco-maven-plugin</artifactId>
				<version>0.8.8</version>
				<executions>
					<execution>
						<goals>
							<goal>prepare-agent</goal>
						</goals>
					</execution>
					<execution>
						<id>generate-code-coverage-report</id>
						<phase>test</phase>
						<goals>
							<goal>report</goal>
						</goals>
					</execution>
				</executions>
			</plugin>
		</plugins>
	</build>

	<profiles>
		<profile>
			<id>uber-jar</id>
			<build>
				<plugins>
					<plugin>
						<groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
						<artifactId>maven-shade-plugin</artifactId>
						<version>3.5.0</version>
						<configuration>
							<createDependencyReducedPom>false</createDependencyReducedPom>

steps.message:
The Maven compilation now succeeds. Here's a summary of what was done:

## Summary

The `tinspin-indexes` dependency was already at version `1.8.0` in the pom.xml, and the code compiles successfully with this version. 

**Change made:**
- Added `<encoding>UTF-8</encoding>` to the maven-compiler-plugin configuration in `pom.xml` to resolve the Unicode character encoding warnings that were appearing during compilation.

The compilation errors shown in the task description were likely related to:
1. **Encoding issues** - Source files contain UTF-8 characters (Greek letters, mathematical symbols) that weren't being properly recognized without explicit encoding configuration
2. The tinspin-indexes API is compatible between versions 1.7.1 and 1.8.0 - the `query1NN()` method exists in both versions as a default method in the `PointIndex` interface

**Files modified:**
- `/PGS/pom.xml` - Added UTF-8 encoding configuration to the maven-compiler-plugin

The build now completes successfully with `mvn compile`.
